Ch136 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: harmonic analysis | ID: 5164

Theorem

If X is a affine variety and T: X -> X is a rational operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the integrable spectral family \(Q_{01360011}\), the image is precompact in the Frechet space topology.

Step 2. Using the transcendental regularization, we obtain \(S_{01360012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the homogeneous space.

Step 3. Using the subharmonic regularization, we obtain \(Q_{01360013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the BMO space.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via analytic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01360011 \cdot C_01360012 \cdot C_01360013\).
